name: Salmon-Bell Pepper Skewers with Grilled Bok Choy & Cauliflower Rice

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 8-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium head cauliflower
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
6 baby bok choy
2 red bell peppers
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl.
Add oil and salt to the bowl with the cauliflower rice, then stir to combine. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp toasted sesame oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cauliflower rice is tender and golden, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in the reserved bowl along with oil, coconut aminos, and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp coconut aminos
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp crushed red pepper
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the marinade.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl, gently stir to coat, and set aside.

Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat. While the pan heats up, using a clean cutting board, trim and cut bok choy in half lengthwise; place on a large plate. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add bok choy, cut-side down, and grill, flipping once, until tender and charred, 4-5 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pan for later use.)

Meanwhile, thread salmon and bell pepper onto the skewers, alternating ingredients; place on another plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the salmon and bell pepper directly on the grill pan.)

Return pan to medium-high heat. Working in batches if necessary, add skewers and grill, turning every 1 ½-2 minutes, until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to the plate with the bok choy.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice, bok choy, skewers, and avocado between plates. Sprinkle skewers with sesame seeds and enjoy!
